segments.title: Deepest EXPLOSIVE eruption: how deep?
segments.say: The deepest explosive volcano rocks ever found. How deep? Three. Two. One.

segments.title: Over 6,000 METERS down!
segments.say: Over six thousand meters! One flow at six thousand one hundred forty eight.

segments.title: Next to the Challenger Deep
segments.say: Right beside the Challenger Deep, where explosions shouldn't happen.
